items.notes: DEVIATION from the triage's double-tap rule ('ignore a touch click less than 350 ms after mount'): e2e/session-driver.ts taps 'Finish now' / 'Skip <axis>' right after the panel opens (touch: isMobile), so a mount-time rule would swallow those taps (and break reveal/session-save/keyboard-style suites on the iphone project). The panel instead ignores a touch press that lands within 350 ms and 32 px of the previous touch anywhere on the page (module-level capture listener on pointerdown), i.e. the second half of a double tap. session-save.spec.ts passes on chromium and iphone with it.

items.notes: PARTIAL on one point: the error stays in the role=status element (with class 'error') instead of switching to role=alert, because reveal-owned e2e/session-save.spec.ts:440-449 reads `getByRole('status')` for 'not a HumanBench save' / 'not valid JSON' and toHaveClass(/error/). The status region is mounted empty before its text, so it is announced. e2e/session-save.spec.ts passes unedited on chromium and iphone. 'Last saved' uses the merged save's created_utc (the last write) and counts power items of its newest session; the clock is the save library's wallClockMs (timing-lint).

integration_requests.change: Line 367, in 'the static fallback (the default build) is untouched': `await expect(page.locator('footer a')).toHaveCount(0)` no longer holds, the footer now always links 'Privacy and terms' (#/privacy). Replace it with `await expect(page.locator('footer a[href="#/data"]')).toHaveCount(0)` (the data page link is still only there with a server). I did not run server.spec.ts.

Line 212 (`const DARK = '@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)'`) and the parsers that read dark overrides compare the media prelude literally, so the triage's `@media screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (applied by other packages in src/brief/notes.css, src/brief/ui/ResultsTalk.svelte, src/render/common/render.css) fails 'every colour token of src/ sits in a rule that a sheet above stands for' (26 tokens; npm test is otherwise green). Either accept `@media screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` there, or keep the plain query in those files. app.css keeps the plain query and prints through system colours.

Optional follow-up: Ready's error message stays in the role=status paragraph (class 'error') because lines 440-449 read it from getByRole('status'). If the reveal package wants role=alert for errors, those lines must read the alert and the status; then Ready.svelte can render the failure in a separate role=alert element.
Line 97 clicks 'Back' in practice (harness, not a gate). The button is now 'Stop practice' on a question and 'Continue' on 'Practice complete'.
ConfirmPanel now takes primary?: 'yes' | 'no' (default 'yes'). For the leave panel pass primary="no" (Stay and save first and primary). Not passed from here, as instructed.
Left at <nav aria-label="Session checklist"> as instructed; reveal.spec.ts selects it by role. New: each li carries data-status 'later' (was 'upcoming') for clusters that are not next.
